values.note: Primitive $15 every night; modern (electric and water) $25, $30 on a Saturday; premium (full hookups) $30, $35 on a Saturday; group sites the same per unit. Park page read 2026-11-12.

fees.source: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/grahams-island-state-park ('45 Premium Campsites (electricity, water & sewer) Price: $30-35 per night', '70 Modern Campsites (electricity & water) Price: $25-30 per night', '9 Primitive Campsites Price: $15 per night'); Saturday split from reserveNDparks sampled rates (audit/state_park_fees/nd_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl: modern $25 Tue / $30 Sat, premium $30 / $35, primitive $15 / $15); primitive sites post 40-60 ft in the reservation system so a 23-ft rig fits the base; read 2026-11-12

values.note: 45 premium, 70 modern and 9 primitive single sites plus 32 group sites, in the Ziebach, Howard, LaRose and primitive loops. Every bookable site posts 40 ft or more in the reservation system (primitive 40-60 ft, modern and premium mostly 75-130 ft).

sites.source: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/grahams-island-state-park (45 premium + 5 premium group + 70 modern + 15 modern group + 9 primitive + 12 primitive group = 156); reserveNDparks grid VehicleLength per unit (147 campsites listed, none under 40 ft), read 2026-11-12

values.note: Sewer only at the premium sites; modern sites have electric and water. Amperage not posted.

hookups.source: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/grahams-island-state-park ('Premium Campsites (electricity, water & sewer)', 'Modern Campsites (electricity & water)'), read 2026-11-12

facilities.source: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/grahams-island-state-park (Additional Park Amenities: 'Sewage dump station', 'Showers & flush toilets'), read 2026-11-12

note: Large wooded campground on a peninsula in Devils Lake, in the Ziebach, Howard, LaRose and primitive loops; four-lane boat ramp, bait shop, fish cleaning station, swim beach, visitor center and dog park. --Claude
